title.original: DataDecide: How to Predict Best Pretraining Data with Small Experiments
title.zh: DataDecide：如何通过小型实验预测最佳预训练数据
title.en: DataDecide: How to Predict Best Pretraining Data with Small Experiments

inclusion_reason.zh: DataDecide 发布可复现的多语料、多规模决策套件，用低成本实验选择预训练数据，属于数据工程决策基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: DataDecide releases a reproducible multi-corpus, multi-scale decision suite for selecting pretraining data with small runs, qualifying as data-engineering decision infrastructure.

abstract.zh: DataDecide 提供跨语料来源、去重与过滤策略的受控预训练实验套件，用小模型和低成本指标研究哪些数据选择在更大目标模型上仍能保持排序。
abstract.en: DataDecide is a controlled pretraining suite spanning corpus sources, deduplication, and filtering choices, designed to test which small-model signals preserve data-choice rankings at a larger target scale.

problem.zh: 直接用大模型比较候选预训练语料成本过高，但小规模实验、缩放律或代理基准究竟能否可靠预测最佳语料并不清楚。
problem.en: Training large models on every candidate corpus is prohibitively expensive, yet it is unclear whether small runs, scaling laws, or proxy benchmarks reliably identify the best data.

approach.zh: 作者构造多语料、多规模和多随机种子的实验矩阵，比较单一小规模排序、缩放律方法与连续似然代理对目标规模表现的预测能力。
approach.en: The authors build a multi-corpus, multi-scale, multi-seed matrix and compare single-small-scale rankings, scaling-law estimators, and continuous-likelihood proxies for target-scale selection.

system_design.zh: 开放套件把语料处理差异、预训练检查点和统一评测绑定为可复现实验矩阵，再由决策模块根据小规模观测选择候选语料。
system_design.en: The open suite couples corpus-processing variants, pretraining checkpoints, and common evaluations into a reproducible matrix, after which a decision layer selects data using small-run observations.

key_results.zh: 单一小模型的排序已是很强的选择基线；所测缩放律没有稳定越过其计算—决策前沿，而连续似然指标对多项下游基准具有较好的预测性。
key_results.en: A single small-model ranking is already a strong selector; the tested scaling laws do not consistently beat its compute-decision frontier, while continuous-likelihood signals predict several downstream benchmarks well.

limitations.zh: 实验规模仍远低于前沿训练，结论可能随架构、token 预算和数据领域变化；代理指标的可预测性也不等于对安全、公平或长尾质量的覆盖。
limitations.en: The study remains below frontier scale and may shift with architecture, token budget, or domain; predictive proxy metrics also do not cover safety, fairness, or long-tail data quality.

metrics.name: Correct target-scale pairwise predictions from small-model ranking
Compute used for continuous-likelihood proxy prediction

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; undisclosed table details, hardware topology, and cluster configuration still require full-text audit.
